description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for accessing recent search query data stored in a database, using Room persistence library annotations. It includes methods to retrieve, insert, and clear recent search queries.

classes.name: RecentSearchQueryDao
classes.description: DAO interface for accessing recent search query entities, providing methods to query, insert, and delete recent search queries.

methods.name: getRecentSearchQueryEntities
methods.description: Returns a flow of a list of RecentSearchQueryEntity objects, ordered by queried date descending, limited by the provided parameter.

methods.name: insertOrReplaceRecentSearchQuery
methods.description: Suspends and inserts or replaces a given RecentSearchQueryEntity into the database.

methods.name: clearRecentSearchQueries
methods.description: Suspends and deletes all entries from the recentSearchQueries table.
